commands.author: wangmiao0668000666

target.title: fix(matrix): journal inbound events before advancing sync token
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Matrix loses inbound user messages when the gateway crashes or restarts while an agent turn is running.

The loss window is structural: matrix-js-sdk's `doSync` sets the sync token **before** processing the batch's events ("set the sync token NOW *before* processing the events … so if something barfs on an event we can skip it" — `node_modules/matrix-js-sdk/lib/sync.js:725-728`). The plugin's `SqliteBackedMatrixSyncStore.setSyncData` then persists that token (`extensions/matrix/src/matrix/client/file-sync-store.ts:227-232`, 250 ms debounce). Meanwhile the SDK bridge re-emits the event synchronously (`extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk.ts:2073-2086`) and the monitor dispatched it **detached** into a memory-only `KeyedAsyncQueue` (`extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts:539`) for the full agent-turn duration.

So the sequence was: message arrives → token advanced in memory → next `/sync` tells the homeserver the batch is consumed → token persisted to SQLite — all while the message still sits in a memory-only queue. Any crash in that window (routinely minutes, the whole agent turn) permanently loses the message. The existing persistent inbound deduper only stores dedupe records, not the payload, so nothing can replay it.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is the same crash window the durable-ingress fleet adoption (#109657) already closed on the sibling channels — telegram (#108924), discord (#110274), whatsapp (#110418), mattermost (#110386), msteams (#110357), slack (#109910), signal (#109907), imessage (#110409), sms (#109866) — and Matrix is the remaining sync-loop channel still on detached in-memory dispatch. This PR mirrors the merged Mattermost adapter (`extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-ingress.ts`) one-for-one, mapped onto Matrix's ack equivalent (the sync-token persist instead of a websocket receive):

- New `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/ingress.ts`: every dispatchable inbound event (room message, decrypted message, reaction) is journaled into the shared `channel_ingress_events` queue **synchronously inside the sync event listener**. The queue's SQLite write is a synchronous transaction (`src/state/openclaw-state-db.ts` `runOpenClawStateWriteTransaction`), so the journal row commits in the same macrotask cycle — before the 250 ms-debounced token persist can tell the homeserver the batch is consumed. Durable-before-ack.
- Dispatch now runs through the core durable ingress drain (`createChannelIngressDrain`) with per-room lanes (`room:<id>`, matching the handler's existing per-room serialization), the canonical `turnAdoptionLifecycle` seam (`bindIngressLifecycleToReplyOptions` → `core.channel.inbound.run`, so the claim tombstones at adoption when the turn's recovery state is durable), bounded retry with backoff and dead-letter (8 attempts / 24 h, shared defaults), and startup replay of journaled rows.
- Handler failures now propagate to the drain when journaled (the detached path swallowed them) so the retry/dead-letter policy owns them; terminal non-turn outcomes (policy gates, dedupe skips) tombstone on dispatch return. The pre-existing persistent deduper keeps homeserver redeliveries exactly-once on top of the drain's tombstones.
- Events without an `event_id` cannot be journaled and keep the previous live-dispatch path (`onUnjournaledEvent`), matching the handler's existing fail-open dedupe behavior for unidentifiable events.
- Journal-append failure retries (0/100/300 ms) then drops loudly (fail closed), mirroring the whatsapp landing decision; because the journal and the sync-token store share the same state DB, a broken DB fails the token persist too, so the homeserver redelivers after restart.
- Shutdown stops ingress after `drainPendingDecryptions` (those emissions still need the journal) and awaits in-flight drain dispatches exactly where the old detached-task `waitForIdle` stood.

No SQLite schema change (reuses the existing `channel_ingress_events` table in the shared state DB), no new config or env surface, no core/SDK changes — the adapter only consumes the already-exported seams (`createChannelIngressDrain`, `bindIngressLifecycleToReplyOptions`, `state.openChannelIngressQueue`).

Known boundary (follow-up candidate, out of scope): E2EE events are journaled when the decrypt bridge emits the decrypted event; a crash between token persist and decryption still loses the still-encrypted event. Closing that needs re-injecting raw encrypted events into the crypto pipeline on replay, which is a separate design.

## User Impact

- A gateway crash/restart during (or before) an agent turn no longer permanently loses Matrix room messages, decrypted messages, or reactions: journaled events replay once on startup and are deduped against already-handled ones.
- Handler failures retry with bounded backoff and dead-letter loudly instead of vanishing into a detached-task log line.
- No operator action, config change, or migration required; behavior on the happy path is unchanged (same per-room serialization, same reply pipeline).

## Evidence

### Loss-window walkthrough (before)

| Step | Where | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `/sync` batch arrives | `node_modules/matrix-js-sdk/lib/sync.js:725-728` | token set **before** event processing |
| token persisted | `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/client/file-sync-store.ts:227-232` | homeserver may consider batch consumed after 250 ms debounce |
| event re-emitted | `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk.ts:2073-2086` | sync, during batch processing |
| dispatch | `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/events.ts` (old) | detached `void runMonitorTask(...)` into memory-only queue |
| agent turn | `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts:539` | message lives only in process memory for minutes |

Crash anywhere after the persist → message gone. After this PR, the journal row exists in SQLite before the listener returns, the drain dispatches with heartbeats + lane serialization, and rows tombstone only at adoption/completion.

### Regression tests (real SQLite queue, temp state dir, no mocks of the journal path)

New `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/ingress.test.ts` (6 tests) drives the real `channel_ingress_events` queue via `createChannelIngressQueueForTests` over a real temp state DB:

- journal row commits in the same macrotask cycle as `accept()` (before any timer-based persist could fire), dispatch not started;
- **restart replay**: accept → simulated crash (no stop) → fresh monitor over the same state dir dispatches the journaled event exactly once and tombstones it;
- completed events are not redispatched across a restart;
- a throwing dispatch is **not** tombstoned — a later process redelivers it (retry budget), then completes;
- events without an `event_id` fall back to live dispatch and journal nothing;
- end-to-end through the real `registerMatrixMonitorEvents` wiring: a synchronous `room.message` emission (as the SDK bridge does inside `doSync`) is durable immediately after the listener returns, then replays once after a restart.

Plus `handler.test.ts`: the handler threads the ingress lifecycle into `core.channel.inbound.run` as `turnAdoptionLifecycle` (`admission: "exclusive"`, `onAdopted`/`onAbandoned` passthrough). `index.test.ts`: handler failures surface to the drain, and shutdown ordering is pause-sync → drain decryptions → ingress stop (awaits in-flight) → thread-binding stop → client release.

### Test runs

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/ingress.test.ts \
    extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/index.test.ts \
    extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/events.test.ts \
    extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.test.ts
Test Files  4 passed (4)
Tests  211 passed (211)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/
Test Files  35 passed (35)
Tests  484 passed (484)
```

(The full monitor-directory run is intermittently 7-red in `reaction-events.test.ts` with `runtime.state.resolveStateDir is not a function`; reproduced on unmodified `origin/main` 1/4 runs with the identical signature — pre-existing cross-file flake, unrelated to this change.)

### Reverse verification (control-red)

Stashed only the four production files (`events.ts`, `handler.ts`, `index.ts`, `ingress.ts`), kept the tests:

```
Test Files  4 failed (4)   ← ingress import gone, wiring assertions red
Tests  6 failed | 199 passed (205)
```

Restored the fix → same four files green (211/211).

### tsgo / lint / format

```
$ tsgo -p tsconfig.extensions.json
→ only the 3 pre-existing packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts errors (stale ipaddr.js types); zero in touched files
$ oxlint extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/   → clean
$ oxfmt --check extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/ → clean
```
